rows.text_en: Ministry of Government Legislation ( Innovation Administration Audit Division ), 044-200-6554
Chapter 1 General Provisions <Newly Inserted May 26, 2015>

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 법제처에 두는 보조기관ㆍ보좌기관의 직급 및 직급별 정원, 「정부조직법」 제2조제3항 및 제5항에 따라 기획조정관 및 국장 밑에 두는 보조기관과 이에 상당하는 보좌기관의 설치 및 사무분장 등 「법제처 직제」에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다. <개정 2011. 3. 7., 2016. 9. 5.>
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Government Legislation,” such as the ranks and staffing quotas for auxiliary and advisory agencies within the Ministry of Government Legislation , the establishment and division of duties of auxiliary agencies and equivalent advisory agencies placed under the Director General for Planning and Coordination and Directors pursuant to Article 2 , Paragraphs 3 and 5 of the “Government Organization Act,” and matters necessary for their implementation. <Amended Mar. 7, 2011; Sep. 5, 2016>
Chapter 2 Ministry of Government Legislation <Newly Inserted May 26, 2015>

rows.source_ko: 제2조(차장) 차장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 가등급으로 한다. <개정 2013. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Vice Minister) The Vice Minister shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade A. <Amended Dec. 31, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 제3조(대변인의 직급) 대변인은 부이사관 또는 서기관으로 보한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2016. 2. 29.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Rank of Spokesperson) The Spokesperson shall be appointed at the rank of Deputy Director General or Secretary. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Feb. 29, 2016>

Article 4 (Planning and Coordination Officer) ① Under the Planning and Coordination Officer, there shall be a Planning and Finance Officer, an Innovation Administration and Audit Officer, and a Legislative Exchange and Cooperation Officer. <Amended Mar. 27, 2008; Oct. 23, 2009; Mar. 7, 2011; Aug. 13, 2012; Mar. 23, 2013; Sep. 24, 2013; Sep. 5, 2016; Feb. 28, 2017; Nov. 9, 2017; Jul. 30, 2018; Feb. 21, 2022; Sep. 25, 2025; Dec. 30, 2025; May 6, 2026; Jun. 19, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ② 기획조정관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2008. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ② The Director of Planning and Coordination shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, provided that the job grade of the position is Grade B. <Amended Dec. 31, 2008>

③ The Director of Planning and Finance, the Director of Innovation, Administration and Audit, and the Director of Legislative Exchange and Cooperation shall be appointed as Deputy Directors-General or Secretaries. <Amended Feb. 28, 2017; Nov. 9, 2017; Jul. 30, 2018; Nov. 22, 2018; Feb. 21, 2022; Aug. 30, 2023; Sep. 25, 2025; Dec. 30, 2025; May 6, 2026; Jun. 19, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 제5조(운영지원과장의 직급) 운영지원과장은 부이사관 또는 서기관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Rank of Head of Operations Support Division) The Head of Operations Support Division shall be appointed at the rank of Deputy Director or Secretary.

rows.source_ko: 제6조(법제정책국) ① 법제정책국에 법제정책총괄과, 법제조정총괄법제관 1명, 법제조정법제관 3명 및 법제조정지원팀을 둔다. <개정 2018. 3. 30., 2026. 5. 6., 2026. 6. 19.>
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Legislative Policy Bureau) ① The Legislative Policy Bureau shall have the Legislative Policy Coordination Division, one Legislative Coordination Officer, three Legislative Coordination Officers, and the Legislative Coordination Support Team. <Amended Mar. 30, 2018; May 6, 2026; June 19, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ② 국장 및 법제조정정책관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2022. 12. 27.>
rows.text_en: ② The Director and the Director for Legislative Policy Coordination shall be appointed as general civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service, provided that the job grade of such positions is Grade B. <Amended Dec. 27, 2022>

rows.source_ko: ③ 법제조정정책관은 「법제처 직제」 제7조제3항제2호, 제11호 및 제12호의 사항에 관하여 법제정책국장을 보좌한다. <신설 2022. 12. 27.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Director General for Legislative Policy Coordination assists the Director General of the Legislative Policy Bureau with respect to matters under Article 7, Paragraph 3 , Subparagraphs 2 , 11 , and 12 of the Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Government Legislation. <Newly added Dec. 27, 2022>

rows.source_ko: ④ 법제정책총괄과장, 법제조정총괄법제관 및 법제조정법제관은 부이사관 또는 서기관으로 보하고, 법제조정지원팀장은 서기관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다. <개정 2022. 12. 27., 2026. 5. 6., 2026. 6. 19.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Director of the Legislative Policy Coordination Division, the Chief Legislative Officer for Legislative Coordination, and the Legislative Officer for Legislative Coordination shall be appointed as Deputy Directors or Senior Officials, and the Head of the Legislative Coordination Support Team shall be appointed as a Senior Official or Administrative Officer. <Amended Dec. 27, 2022; May 6, 2026; June 19, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 2. 법제조정 모니터링에 따른 부처 간 협의 여부 확인 등 사후 관리
rows.text_en: 2. Post-management, including verification of inter-ministerial consultations following legislative coordination monitoring

rows.source_ko: 3. 국회에서 발의되는 행정 분야, 경제 분야 및 사회ㆍ문화 분야 등 법률안에 대한 검토ㆍ분석 지원
rows.text_en: 3. Support for the review and analysis of bills proposed in the National Assembly in the administrative, economic, and social and cultural sectors.

rows.source_ko: 4. 국회에서 발의되는 행정 분야, 경제 분야 및 사회ㆍ문화 분야 등 법률안 관련 정부입법정책협의회 상정 안건의 작성 지원
rows.text_en: 4. Support for drafting agenda items to be submitted to the Government Legislative Policy Council regarding bills proposed in the National Assembly in the administrative, economic, and social and cultural sectors.

rows.source_ko: 5. 국회에서 발의되는 행정 분야, 경제 분야 및 사회ㆍ문화 분야 등 법률안 관련 소관 중앙행정기관에 대한 법제 지원 협조
rows.text_en: 5. Cooperation in legislative support for relevant central administrative agencies regarding bills proposed in the National Assembly in the administrative, economic, and social and cultural sectors

rows.source_ko: 6. 법제조정 모니터링 관련 통계 및 사례 관리
rows.text_en: 6. Statistics and Case Management Related to Legislative Coordination Monitoring

[This Article was newly added on Sep. 5, 2016.]
[Former Article 6 was moved to Article 7 <September 5, 2016>]

rows.source_ko: 제6조의2(법령정비국) ① 법령정비국에 법령정비총괄과, 법령정비지원과, 법령품질개선과 및 행정규칙심사정비팀을 둔다.
rows.text_en: Article 6-2 (Legislation Revision Bureau) ① The Legislation Revision Bureau shall have the Legislation Revision General Division, the Legislation Revision Support Division, the Legislation Quality Improvement Division, and the Administrative Rule Review and Revision Team.

rows.source_ko: ② 국장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Director shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ③ 법령정비총괄과장, 법령정비지원과장 및 법령품질개선과장은 부이사관 또는 서기관으로 보하고, 행정규칙심사정비팀장은 서기관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the General Legislation Revision Division, the Head of the Legislation Revision Support Division, and the Head of the Legislation Quality Improvement Division shall be appointed as Deputy Director Generals or Senior Officials, and the Head of the Administrative Rule Review and Revision Team shall be appointed as a Senior Official or Administrative Officer.
④ The Head of the General Affairs Division for Legislative Revision shall be responsible for the following matters.
1. Overall management and coordination of legislative reform tasks
2. Establishment and Implementation of the Basic Plan for Legislative Reform
3. Establishment of Standards for Legislative Revision

rows.source_ko: 4. 불합리한 법령 정비를 위한 전수조사 및 분석
rows.text_en: 4. Comprehensive survey and analysis for the revision of unreasonable laws and regulations

rows.source_ko: 5. 규제개혁 등 주요 현안 해결을 위한 법령의 발굴ㆍ정비
rows.text_en: 5. Identification and refinement of laws to resolve major pending issues, such as regulatory reform

rows.source_ko: 6. 법령정비 관련 통계 및 사례 관리
rows.text_en: 6. Management of Statistics and Cases Related to Legislative Revision

rows.source_ko: 7. 그 밖에 법령정비에 관하여 국 내 다른 과, 팀의 주관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Other matters regarding the revision of laws and regulations that do not fall under the jurisdiction of other divisions or teams within the bureau
⑤ The Head of the Legislation and Regulation Support Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 국민 제안 사항 등 국민 생활에 불편을 주는 법령의 발굴ㆍ정비
rows.text_en: 1. Identification and revision of laws and regulations that cause inconvenience to the public, including public suggestions
2. Revision of laws and regulations to strengthen autonomous legislative power
3. Revision of laws and regulations declared unconstitutional

rows.source_ko: 4. 법령 용어ㆍ문장 순화 업무의 총괄 및 조정
rows.text_en: 4. Overall management and coordination of tasks for purifying legal terminology and sentences

rows.source_ko: 5. 법령 용어ㆍ문장 순화 관련 조사 및 연구
rows.text_en: 5. Survey and Research on the Purification of Legal Terminology and Sentences
6. Establishment of Standards for Revising Laws and Regulations for Easy Understanding
7. Research and Development on Visualization of Easy-to-Understand Legal Information
⑥ The Head of the Legislation Quality Improvement Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 법령 품질 개선 업무의 총괄 및 조정
rows.text_en: 1. Overall management and coordination of legislative quality improvement work

rows.source_ko: 2. 「행정기본법 시행령」 제17조에 따른 입법영향분석 제도의 운영
rows.text_en: 2. Operation of the Legislative Impact Analysis System pursuant to Article 17 of the Enforcement Decree of the Framework Act on Government Administration
3. Establishment of standards for post-management of legal reforms

rows.source_ko: 4. 법령 품질 개선을 위한 법령의 조사ㆍ연구
rows.text_en: 4. Research and study of laws and regulations to improve the quality of laws and regulations
5. Support for the identification and revision of unreasonable laws

rows.source_ko: 6. 「법제업무 운영규정」 제24조의3에 따른 법령의 일괄정비 협업체계 구축 및 입법지원
rows.text_en: 6. Establishment of a collaborative system for the comprehensive revision of laws and regulations and legislative support pursuant to Article 24-3 of the "Regulations on the Operation of Legislative Affairs"

rows.source_ko: 7. 그 밖에 법령 품질 개선에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Other matters concerning the improvement of the quality of laws and regulations
⑦ The Head of the Administrative Rules Review and Maintenance Team is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 훈령ㆍ예규 등의 심사와 개선 업무의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Overall management and coordination of review and improvement of directives, regulations, etc.

rows.source_ko: 2. 규제를 포함한 훈령ㆍ예규 등의 사전 검토 및 그 결과의 통보
rows.text_en: 2. Prior review of directives, established rules, etc., including regulations, and notification of the results

rows.source_ko: 3. 훈령ㆍ예규 등의 사전ㆍ사후 검토와 관련된 제도 및 절차의 개선
rows.text_en: 3. Improvement of systems and procedures related to prior and subsequent review of directives, regulations, etc.

rows.source_ko: 4. 훈령ㆍ예규 등에 대한 정비과제의 정비현황 점검ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 4. Inspection and management of the status of maintenance tasks regarding directives, regulations, etc.

rows.source_ko: 5. 훈령ㆍ예규 등의 존속기한, 재검토기한 등 일몰제의 운영 현황 점검ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 5. Inspection and management of the operation status of sunset clauses, such as the duration and review periods of directives and established regulations
6. Inspection and Management of Registration Status of Directives, Circulars, etc.
7. Management and Operation of Presidential Instructions and Circulars

rows.source_ko: 8. 그 밖에 훈령ㆍ예규 등의 심사 및 정비에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Other matters concerning the examination and maintenance of instructions, regulations, etc.
[This Article Newly Inserted May 6, 2026]

rows.source_ko: 제7조(각 법제국장ㆍ법제심의관 및 법제관의 직무등급 등) ① 행정법제국장ㆍ경제법제국장 및 사회문화법제국장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2008. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Job Grades, etc., of the Director-General of the Legislation Bureau, the Senior Legislative Advisor, and the Legislative Advisor) ① The Director-General of the Administrative Legislation Bureau, the Director-General of the Economic Legislation Bureau, and the Director-General of the Social and Cultural Legislation Bureau shall be appointed as general civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of their positions shall be Grade B. <Amended Dec. 31, 2008>

rows.source_ko: ② 각 법제국장 밑에 두는 법제심의관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2008. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ② Legislative Review Officers placed under each Director of the Legislation Bureau shall be appointed as general civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of such positions shall be Grade B. <Amended Dec. 31, 2008>

rows.source_ko: ③ 각 법제국장 밑에 두는 법제관은 부이사관 또는 서기관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: ③ Legislative officers placed under each Director of the Legislative Bureau shall be appointed as Deputy Directors or Secretaries.
[Moved from Article 6, former Article 7 moved to Article 8 <September 5, 2016>]

rows.source_ko: 제8조(법령해석국) ① 법령해석국에 법령해석총괄과, 행정법령해석과, 경제법령해석1과, 경제법령해석2과 및 사회문화법령해석과를 둔다. <개정 2016. 9. 5., 2021. 2. 25.>
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Bureau of Legal Interpretation) ① The Bureau of Legal Interpretation shall be established with the General Division of Legal Interpretation, the Division of Administrative Legal Interpretation, the Division of Economic Legal Interpretation 1, the Division of Economic Legal Interpretation 2, and the Division of Social and Cultural Legal Interpretation. <Amended Sep. 5, 2016; Feb. 25, 2021>

rows.source_ko: ② 국장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2008. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ② A Director shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, provided that the job grade of the position is Grade B. <Amended Dec. 31, 2008>

rows.source_ko: ③ 법령해석총괄과장, 행정법령해석과장, 경제법령해석1과장, 경제법령해석2과장 및 사회문화법령해석과장은 부이사관 또는 서기관으로 보한다. <개정 2016. 9. 5., 2021. 2. 25.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the General Division for Legal Interpretation, the Head of the Division for Administrative Legal Interpretation, the Head of the Division for Economic Legal Interpretation 1, the Head of the Division for Economic Legal Interpretation 2, and the Head of the Division for Social and Cultural Legal Interpretation shall be appointed as Deputy Directors or Senior Officials. <Amended Sep. 5, 2016; Feb. 25, 2021>
④ The Head of the General Affairs Division for Legal Interpretation shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Dec. 31, 2008; Apr. 18, 2012; Sep. 5, 2016; Jun. 17, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 1. 법령해석 요청안건의 상정 등 법령해석심의위원회의 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning the operation of the Committee on Legal Interpretation, such as the submission of agenda items requesting legal interpretation
2. Research, improvement, and overall management and coordination regarding the legal interpretation system

rows.source_ko: 3. 법령해석에 관한 문서의 접수ㆍ발송ㆍ통제 및 보존
rows.text_en: 3. Receipt, dispatch, control, and preservation of documents regarding legal interpretation

rows.source_ko: 4. 각급 행정기관의 법령해석제도 운영에 관한 현황조사 및 지도
rows.text_en: 4. Survey of current status and guidance on the operation of legal interpretation systems in administrative agencies at all levels
5. Investigation and Analysis of Cases of Legal Interpretation
6. Deleted <Aug. 13, 2012>

rows.source_ko: 7. 그 밖에 국 내 다른 과의 주관에 속하지 아니하는 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other divisions within the bureau

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 행정법령해석과장은 감사원, 국가인권위원회, 교육부, 외교부, 통일부, 국방부, 행정안전부, 국가보훈부, 대통령비서실, 국가안보실, 대통령경호처, 국가정보원, 국무조정실, 국무총리비서실, 인사혁신처, 법제처, 국민권익위원회, 개인정보 보호위원회, 재외동포청, 병무청, 방위사업청, 경찰청, 소방청 및 중대범죄수사청 소관 법령과 그 밖에 다른 과의 주관에 속하지 않는 법령에 대한 해석요청안건의 검토, 법령해석심의위원회의 회의록 및 회신문의 작성에 관한 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2012. 4. 18., 2012. 8. 13., 2013. 3. 23., 2014. 11. 19., 2016. 9. 5., 2017. 8. 3., 2021. 2. 25., 2024. 2. 27., 2026. 10. 2.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Head of the Administrative Law Interpretation Division is responsible for reviewing requests for interpretation of laws and regulations under the jurisdiction of the Board of Audit and Inspection, the National Human Rights Commission, the Ministry of Education, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Ministry of Unification, the Ministry of National Defense, the Ministry of the Interior and Safety, the Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs, the Presidential Secretariat, the National Security Office, the Presidential Security Service, the National Intelligence Service, the Office of Government Coordination, the Prime Minister's Secretariat, the Ministry of Personnel Management, the Ministry of Government Legislation, the Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission, the Personal Information Protection Commission, the Overseas Koreans Agency, the Military Manpower Administration, the Defense Acquisition Program Administration, the National Police Agency, the National Fire Agency, and the Serious Crimes Investigation Agency, as well as other laws and regulations not under the jurisdiction of other divisions, and for drafting minutes of meetings and replies of the Law Interpretation Deliberation Committee. <Amended Apr. 18, 2012; Aug. 13, 2012; Mar. 23, 2013; Nov. 19, 2014; Sep. 5, 2016; Aug. 3, 2017; Feb. 25, 2021; Feb. 27, 2024; Oct. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 경제법령해석1과장은 국토교통부 소관 법령 중 도시ㆍ건축 및 주택 분야 법령에 대한 해석요청안건의 검토, 법령해석심의위원회의 회의록 및 회신문의 작성에 관한 사항을 분장한다. <신설 2021. 2. 25.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Head of the Economic Law Interpretation Division 1 shall be responsible for matters concerning the review of requests for interpretation regarding laws in the urban, architectural, and housing sectors under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, as well as the drafting of minutes and replies for the Legal Interpretation Deliberation Committee. <Newly added Feb. 25, 2021>

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 경제법령해석2과장은 재정경제부, 과학기술정보통신부, 산업통상부, 국토교통부, 중소벤처기업부, 기획예산처, 방송미디어통신위원회, 공정거래위원회, 금융위원회, 원자력안전위원회, 국가데이터처, 지식재산처, 국세청, 관세청, 조달청, 우주항공청, 행정중심복합도시건설청 및 새만금개발청 소관 법령(경제법령해석1과의 소관 법령은 제외한다)에 대한 해석요청안건의 검토, 법령해석심의위원회의 회의록 및 회신문의 작성에 관한 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2012. 4. 18., 2012. 8. 13., 2013. 3. 23., 2016. 9. 5., 2017. 8. 3., 2021. 2. 25., 2024. 2. 27., 2025. 10. 31., 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Head of the Economic Law Interpretation Division 2 is responsible for reviewing requests for interpretation of laws and regulations under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Finance and Economy, the Ministry of Science and ICT, the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy, the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, the Ministry of SMEs and Startups, the Ministry of Planning and Budget, the Korea Communications Commission, the Fair Trade Commission, the Financial Services Commission, the Nuclear Safety and Security Commission, the National Data Agency, the Intellectual Property Office, the National Tax Service, the Korea Customs Service, the Public Procurement Service, the Korea Aerospace and Aerospace Agency, the Sejong City Construction Agency, and the Saemangeum Development Authority (excluding laws and regulations under the jurisdiction of the Economic Law Interpretation Division 1), and for drafting minutes of the Law Interpretation Deliberation Committee meetings and replies. <Amended Apr. 18, 2012; Aug. 13, 2012; Mar. 23, 2013; Sep. 5, 2016; Aug. 3, 2017; Feb. 25, 2021; Feb. 27, 2024; Oct. 31, 2025; Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ⑧ 사회문화법령해석과장은 문화체육관광부, 농림축산식품부, 보건복지부, 기후에너지환경부, 고용노동부, 성평등가족부, 해양수산부, 식품의약품안전처, 국가유산청, 농촌진흥청, 산림청, 질병관리청, 기상청 및 해양경찰청 소관 법령에 대한 해석요청안건의 검토, 법령해석심의위원회의 회의록 및 회신문의 작성에 관한 사항을 분장한다. <신설 2012. 4. 18., 2012. 8. 13., 2013. 3. 23., 2014. 11. 19., 2016. 9. 5., 2017. 8. 3., 2021. 2. 25., 2024. 2. 27., 2025. 10. 31.>
rows.text_en: ⑧ The Head of the Social and Cultural Legislation Interpretation Division shall be responsible for matters concerning the review of requests for interpretation regarding laws under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism, the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, the Ministry of Health and Welfare, the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment, the Ministry of Employment and Labor, the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family, the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries, the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety, the National Heritage Administration, the Rural Development Administration, the Korea Forest Service, the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency, the Korea Meteorological Administration, and the Korea Coast Guard, as well as the drafting of minutes and replies of the Legislation Interpretation Deliberation Committee. <Newly added Apr. 18, 2012; Aug. 13, 2012; Mar. 23, 2013; Nov. 19, 2014; Sep. 5, 2016; Aug. 3, 2017; Feb. 25, 2021; Feb. 27, 2024; Oct. 31, 2025>

[Title amended Sep. 5, 2016]
[Moved from Article 7; former Article 8 moved to Article 11 <September 5, 2016>]
Article 8-2 Deleted <September 5, 2016>

rows.source_ko: 제9조(법제정보지원국) ① 법제정보지원국에 법령정보총괄과, 국가법령정보센터, 자치법제지원과, 법제교육과 및 법제교육운영팀을 둔다. <개정 2026. 10. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Legislative Information Support Bureau) ① The Legislative Information Support Bureau shall be established with the General Legal Information Division, the National Legal Information Center, the Local Legislation Support Division, the Legislative Education Division, and the Legislative Education Operations Team. <Amended Oct. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ② 국장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Director shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ③ 법령정보총괄과장 및 국가법령정보센터장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보하고, 자치법제지원과장 및 법제교육과장은 부이사관 또는 서기관으로 보하며, 법제교육운영팀장은 서기관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다. <개정 2026. 10. 2.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Director of the General Legal Information Division and the Director of the National Law Information Center shall be appointed as Deputy Director-General, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary; the Director of the Local Legislation Support Division and the Director of the Legislative Education Division shall be appointed as Deputy Director-General or Secretary; and the Director of the Legislative Education Operations Team shall be appointed as Secretary or Administrative Officer. <Amended Oct. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 제2조(직급을 상향 조정하여 한시조직에 배정한 정원에 관한 경과조치) 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제25조제3항에 따라 한시조직에 배정된 별표 4의 정원 2명(고위공무원단 1명, 서기관 1명)은 2029년 5월 5일까지 존속하며, 2029년 5월 6일 이후에는 그에 해당하는 정원은 별표 1 및 별표 2의 정원 중 각각 2명(부이사관 또는 서기관 1명, 서기관 또는 행정사무관 1명)으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transitional Measures Concerning the Quotas Allocated to Temporary Organizations by Upward Adjustment of Ranks)  Pursuant to Article 25, Paragraph 3 of the “General Rules on the Organization and Quotas of Administrative Agencies,” the quota of 2 positions (1 Senior Civil Service member and 1 Secretary) set forth in Annex 4 allocated to temporary organizations shall remain in effect until May 5, 2029, and thereafter, the corresponding quota shall be deemed to be 2 positions each (1 Deputy Director or Secretary, and 1 Secretary or Administrative Officer) among the quotas set forth in Annex 1 and Annex 2.
